newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara denies saying recent dlr rise too rapid.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara denies saying recent dlr rise too rapid.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Japanese Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, on Thursday denied market rumours that he had said the dollar's recent rise was too rapid.
"I did not say such a thing at all," he told Reuters.
Sakakibara did not elaborate and also declined to comment on specific exchange rate levels.
The rumours had triggered profit-taking and taken the dollar down from its highs this morning.
Shortly after Sakakibara's denial of the rumour, the dollar recovered to near 113.00 yen. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-5473-3710
